title: #1 Amazing & Beautiful Devotional App!
body: I have been using the Joseph Prince/Gospel Partner app for several years and have always loved it. This latest update introduces the brand new Day & Night Daily Experience. If you are new to the app, there is an initial 7 day devotional that acts as an introduction. The app is now divided into a morning devotion and a night-time devotion (each takes a few minutes; you can set the times), and feature lovely images that evoke peace. The morning devotional starts with an encouraging Scripture-based thought for the day (with Scriptures), a Let’s Talk section which shares Pastor’s thoughts relevant to the topic (you can read and/or listen to audio of it), a Selah & Journal that offers further reflection with questions/prompts that you can journal about and save right inside the app. This then leads to a video excerpt from Pastor Prince. There is also a separate Worship clip. (You can also set streaks in the app to track your devotional practice so as you complete each morning devotional, the app congratulates you with a celebratory message too.) The night-time devotional is a bit shorter but features a soothing evening reflection (also with Scriptures) and another Selah & Journal where you can use the guided prompts and journal your thoughts or prayers in the app. There is also a Scripture Focus quote for the day as well as an additional 7-minute clip from one of Pastor’s sermons (these change daily). I love this app! Not only is it visually beautiful and calming, I believe it is the absolute best for an experience that reveals more of Jesus and draws you into His Presence.

title: For the love of Grace
body: Hello , I am a man that seeks to be more like Jesus on a daily basis. As we all know , with this day and age we live in , that can be very difficult if we lose focus for just a second , as many times I do for the simple fact that it is impossible to stay focused 100% of the time. I make part of my morning prayer , for God to give me strength to fight the battle threw out my day . I believe and know it to be a fact if we put forth the effort to fight , he will meet us in the midst of the battle and intervenes to relieve me for that moment . I consider this app to be a fierce weapon that has God provided for me threw Joseph Prince and his ministrie . I will be forever greatful for Joseph Prince and his ministrie for being a man of God and committing to saving souls threw Christ Jesus . Thank you from the bottom of my heart .
